notes: Universe = routes with a known vehicle capacity; load is recomputed from route stops and compared with the assigned vehicle capacity.
Universe = deliveries whose assignment status is ASSIGNED; a detection requires the delivery to have no route stop.
Universe = assigned deliveries plus deliveries referenced by route stops; a detection requires more than one stop for one delivery.
Universe = route stops with an actual arrival and a preceding actual departure on the same route, ordered by stop sequence.
Universe = routes with an actual end and a resolvable shift planned end; a detection requires actual_end > planned_end.
Universe = customer sites with numeric coordinates inside the global latitude/longitude ranges; the configured region bounds are applied.
